name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured playbook that teaches an AI coding assistant to plan, write, and test software properly instead of rushing straight to code.
buyer: A small software team lead who wants their AI coding assistant to produce more reliable code without constant human babysitting.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it so junior devs' AI-assisted code follows a consistent TDD process instead of producing unreviewed slop.
A dev agency standardizes this methodology across client projects to improve delivered code quality and reduce rework.
A solo indie hacker uses it to run multi-hour autonomous coding sessions with less oversight needed.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid training/onboarding workshops that teach dev teams to adopt this workflow effectively.

steal_this: Run a one-hour paid workshop teaching a local dev team how to set this up and use it well — straightforward to deliver this weekend.
